source_health: The central University calendar API returned 134 raw listings across both pages for October 8–15. Clinical screenings, employee training, routine wellness classes, and closed professional meetings were searched but not dumped into this student-facing digest.

CampusGroups’ public event service returned 63 events for the window, including Tech Night, Chess Club, Lunch and Labyrinth, and both Late Night trivia sessions. Many venues remain hidden until sign-in; those entries are labeled rather than guessed.

Eastman’s independent calendar supplied 24 listings in the window, most absent from the central calendar. The Gateways festival and Eastman pages are active; livestream and ticket labels above follow the current Eastman listings.

Eastman calls the October 14 concert “George Abraham: CELEBRATE: Opus 90 Completed,” while the central calendar calls it a duo-piano fundraiser for Wilmot. The descriptions, time, venue, performers, and 90th-birthday framing establish that these are the same event, so they are deduplicated above.

MAG currently marks its October 8 Kirigami workshop, October 9 pottery workshop, and October 15 Hugo McCloud curator tour SOLD OUT. The first two are omitted as unavailable; the curator tour remains listed because it is a notable event and the status is clearly flagged.

Athletics’ official responsive calendar and individual sport schedules agree on all 11 varsity events in the window. Home, away, and neutral status are labeled; home venues are taken from the official event data.

Arthur Satz Music is active but lists no River Campus concert between October 8 and 15; its next published concert is October 18. GIDS-AI and Dance/Movement also produced no separately confirmed public event for this window. Simon is active and supplied Thursday’s finance panel; Humanities supplied Wednesday’s Anu Ahmed seminar.

Event pages remain the authority for last-minute changes, admission, and registration. This is a broad, curated campus digest—not every appointment, closed meeting, clinical training, or recurring workout.
